reviews.name: Akansha
reviews.quote: I loved my Tadaboo order! 💗 Everything was so cute. The dumpling squishy is my favourite because it's so soft and fun to squeeze. I also loved the Labubu erasable pens, DIY bracelet set and the 8-piece stationery set. Everything was really nice and packed so beautifully. I am super happy with my goodies and can't wait

reviews.name: Faiz
reviews.quote:
I loved my Tadaboo surprise bag! 🥹💗 The helmet sharpener was so cool, the space sticky notes were out of this world, and the chocolate squishy was SO fun to squeeze! I also loved the magnetic bookmark. Everything was so cute! Can I get another surprise bag, please? 🛍️✨”

Faiz — A happy little Tadaboo fan 🎀

reviews.name: Amber
reviews.quote: I loved the stationery from Tadaboo! 💗 My mom ordered these cute goodies as return gifts for my birthday, and everyone loved them. The fun designs and beautiful colours make them perfect for kids my age, whether it’s for birthdays or just little surprises. We’ll definitely be ordering from Tadaboo again! 🎀✨
